heroData.title: EOR & PEO in Botswana
heroData.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to EOR & PEO in Botswana
heroData.description: Detailed insights and providers for EOR & PEO in Botswana.

steps.title: Quote & Agreement
steps.description: Define role and salary. EOR provides cost sheet including management fee.

steps.title: Employment Contract
steps.description: Draft compliant local contract abiding by Employment Act of Botswana.

steps.title: KYC & Registration
steps.description: Collect employee ID (Omang) and register for tax (PAYE) if applicable.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.description: Setup payroll and welcome employee. No social security enrollment reduces admin.

steps.title: Monthly Payroll
steps.description: Process salary and remit PAYE to BURS.

items.title: Severance
items.text: Severance is mandatory after 5 years of continuous service (1 day pay per month served).

items.title: Termination
items.text: Valid reasons required. Notice period usually equal to pay period (e.g., 1 month).

items.title: Probation
items.text: Typical probation is 3 months, extendable.

faqs.question: Is 13th month pay mandatory?
faqs.answer: No, it is discretionary but common.

faqs.question: What is the standard work week?
faqs.answer: 48 hours maximum, commonly 40-45 hours.

faqs.question: Are background checks legal?
faqs.answer: Yes, with candidate consent.

items.title: Language
items.text: English is the business language; Setswana is widely spoken.

items.title: Currency
items.text: Salaries paid in Pula (BWP).

items.title: Permits
items.text: Work permits for foreigners are strictly regulated.

steps.title: Registration
steps.description: Register employer with BURS for PAYE.

steps.title: Calculation
steps.description: Calculate Gross to Net. Deduct PAYE based on tax tables.

steps.title: Filing
steps.description: Submit monthly returns by the 15th of the following month.

steps.title: Payment
steps.description: Pay net salary to employees and taxes to BURS.

steps.title: Year-End
steps.description: Issue ITW8 certificates (tax certificates) to employees.

items.title: Min Wage
items.text: Adjusted periodically, approx. 4.50-7.00 BWP/hour depending on sector.

items.title: Overtime
items.text: 1.5x for normal overtime, 2.0x for rest days/holidays.

items.title: Leave
items.text: 15 working days paid leave per year minimum.

faqs.question: Is there social security?
faqs.answer: No mandatory state social security scheme for private sector yet.

faqs.question: When is tax due?
faqs.answer: PAYE is due by the 15th of the next month.

faqs.question: Can I pay in USD?
faqs.answer: Contracts usually in BWP; USD payments possible but complicate tax.

items.title: Tax Year
items.text: July 1st to June 30th.

items.title: Payslips
items.text: Mandatory to provide written itemized payslips.

items.title: Banking
items.text: Electronic transfers (EFT) are standard.

steps.title: Determine Gross
steps.description: Calculate total monthly earnings including allowances.

steps.title: Exemptions
steps.description: Deduct exempt contributions (e.g., approved pension fund up to 15%).

steps.title: Annualize
steps.description: Project annual income to determine PAYE tax bracket.

steps.title: Calc PAYE
steps.description: Apply progressive tax rates (0% on first 48k BWP/yr, up to 25%).

steps.title: Final Net
steps.description: Deduct computed PAYE and any other levies (e.g. Training Levy if applicable) to get Net Pay.

items.title: Calculator
items.text: Spreadsheet calculations work well; tax bands are straightforward annually.

items.title: Threshold
items.text: First 48,000 BWP per annum is tax-free for residents.

items.title: Non-Residents
items.text: Subject to different tax scales with no tax-free threshold.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by scope. Typically 2-4 weeks for standard implementations.

faqs.question: Is a local entity needed?
faqs.answer: Depends on the specific service mode. EOR avoids this requirement.

faqs.question: What are the payment terms?
faqs.answer: Standard terms are Net 30 days for established businesses.

faqs.question: Are prices in USD or BWP?
faqs.answer: Mostly BWP locally, but international contracts often use USD.

faqs.question: Is support available?
faqs.answer: Yes, local support is available during business hours (CAT).

steps.title: Name Reservation
steps.description: Reserve company name online via the CIPA OBRS system (approx. 20 BWP).

steps.title: Document Prep
steps.description: Prepare Constitution, Director/Shareholder consent forms, and ID copies.

steps.title: Online Registration
steps.description: Complete registration on CIPA OBRS. Offline registration is no longer available.

steps.title: Beneficial Ownership
steps.description: Mandatory declaration of beneficial owners during the registration process.

steps.title: Tax Registration
steps.description: Obtain TIN and register for VAT with BURS if turnover > 1M BWP (or voluntary > 500k).

items.title: Private Company
items.text: Most common (Proprietary Limited - Pty Ltd). Max 25 shareholders.

items.title: IFSC
items.text: International Financial Services Centre companies get 15% tax rate.

items.title: Director
items.text: At least one director must be resident in Botswana.

faqs.question: Is a resident director required?
faqs.answer: Yes, at least one director must be ordinarily resident.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: CIPA is fast; typically 1-3 days for registration.

faqs.question: Min capital?
faqs.answer: No minimum capital requirement.

items.title: Online System
items.text: CIPA OBRS system is fully digital.

items.title: Company Secretary
items.text: Required for all companies.

items.title: Annual Returns
items.text: Must be filed annually with CIPA.
